purpose: Remove the failing runtime Brotli presentation route. Materialize the already approved deterministic 14-page presentation during the web build and let Next.js serve the generated public PDF from the unchanged download URL.
requiredBehavior: No Brotli decompression or PDF reconstruction runs in the production request path.
The build fails if the approved presentation source cannot be reconstructed or validated.
The generated PDF preserves the approved 14-page presentation and Gekta frame correction.
Two independent production downloads must return HTTP 200, application/pdf and identical non-empty PDF bytes.
forbiddenChanges: authentication, registration, API, database, roles, tenants or Gekta runtime logic
production release gates, secrets, external storage or recurring cost
